description:
Why: defk-dtw.11 settled the C-compiler stance: a toolchain at build time is acceptable for app developers (like elixir_make packages), and 'the named way out for Hex library authors is precompiled artefacts in the cc_precompiler / rustler_precompiled style (built per target in CI, downloaded and checked by hash; defk's hash-keyed build cache fits this), named in the verdict only, nothing built in this map.' Nothing tracks building it. A library that uses defk internally would today force every user of that library to have a C compiler. defk-djy.8 (Hex readiness) makes defk itself publishable but does not cover libraries built on it.

Gated on the verdict: only worth doing if defk-sgw.5 concludes 'grow into a library'.

Scope:
1. Design: how a library declares its targets, how the kernel libraries are built per target in CI (the build cache key already holds the C source hash, runtime, flags, ERTS version and compiler; which parts must match at download time), how a user's build finds and verifies a downloaded artefact (checksum file in the package, as rustler_precompiled does), and the fallback to a local build when no artefact matches. Interaction with defk-n8f's ebin layout and with defk-ulk's architecture builds (portable vs target levels).
2. A prototype on one small library with two targets.
3. An ADR recording the shape (or why not).

Done when: the ADR is written and the prototype shows a library's user compiling with no C compiler on a supported target, with checksum verification and the local-build fallback tested.

comments.text: Deferred 2026-10-13: gated on the verdict (defk-sgw.5) and named there only, per defk-dtw.11.

Deferral trigger corrected 2026-10-20: the written trigger (defk-sgw.6 closing) fired on 2026-10-14 with the verdict go = keep developing. The real gate is the owner's next map: this work waits until the measurement map (defk-w8r) is done and the owner charts what comes after. The date 2027-01-15 is a placeholder so that bw list --overdue stays quiet; set the real date when the plan is charted.

title: Precompiled kernel artefacts for Hex libraries that ship kernels (cc_precompiler style)
